subject: Brightline: LLM data-use entitlements, 'no-model-learning' scope, and operational evidence
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightline.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Alan Cho <alan.cho@brightline.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood DPA — request for explicit no-model-learning clause + response IP

Tessa,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per Brightline's procurement checklist we need: 1) an explicit "no-model-learning" commitment covering both prompts and responses produced for our tenants (no use for model improvement or continual training), 2) clear assignment/licensing of responses so Brightline has a perpetual, worldwide, transferable license to customer-facing outputs, and 3) operational evidence showing subprocessor routing and deletion workflows for prompt logs and ephemeral KV caches.

We attached a redline showing proposed language; please confirm whether Redwood can agree as-is or whether you need to propose alternative wording. Also include expected timelines for providing: a) KMS residency options, b) subprocessor inventory for the Dedicated pool, and c) a short proof-of-deletion runbook. We plan to present the final DPA changes to our legal ops committee next week.

Appreciate a point-by-point response.

Sara Lin
General Counsel, Brightline Financial
--- Attachment: Brightline_DPA_redline_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightline.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA — request for explicit no-model-learning clause + response IP

Sara — thanks for the clear list and the redline. We're prioritizing this for Brightline. High-level summary below and we'll follow with a legal + ops matrix: 

1) No-model-learning commitment: Redwood is prepared to accept a scoped "no-model-learning" commitment for Brightline traffic on Hosted and Dedicated modes. We need to confirm exceptions for aggregated telemetry that is strictly operational (latency/error metrics with no customer content).

2) Output licensing: we can offer a perpetual license to outputs generated for Brightline customers. We need to finalize the exact license text (assignment vs. exclusive license) — legal to propose.

3) Operational evidence & subprocessor disclosures: Ops can produce a subprocessor inventory for the Dedicated pool and a proof-of-deletion runbook for prompt logs & ephemeral caches (we'll outline retention windows and pragmatic deletion semantics). KMS residency (onshore KMS options) is available for Dedicated and Private deployments — we will provide a KMS options summary and ETA.

Action items: 
- Rachel: draft counter-proposed DPA language for no-model-learning + output license (deliver 11/9 EOD).
- Dev: prepare a one-page operations evidence pack (subprocessor list, deletion runbook, KMS options) by 11/10 noon PT.
- Laura: I'll coordinate timing on procurement/contract and loop in sales ops.

We'll aim to send a consolidated response and a DocuSign-ready DPA by 11/10. If you have a hard deadline for the committee please share.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA — request for explicit no-model-learning clause + response IP

Team — draft counters and operational checklist below (high level). I'm attaching a marked DPA and a short operations checklist for their review.

Legal counters (summary):
- No-model-learning: propose: "Redwood will not use Brightline transmitted content (prompts, files, and generated responses) to train or improve base or derivative models. Exceptions limited to aggregated telemetry for service reliability and safety, which will be pseudonymized and not used to modify model weights."
- Output license: propose a "perpetual, non-exclusive, transferable license to generated outputs" with an option for assignment for a fee (if Brightline requires exclusivity we need to escalate to sales leadership; assignment changes commercial pricing).
- Representations: confirm prohibition extends to subcontractors/subprocessors but allow Redwood to route processing to Approved Dedicated Locations (documented).

Ops checklist (Dev to finish into a pack):
- Subprocessor inventory for Dedicated clusters (include physical region and access control summary)
- Proof-of-deletion runbook: steps, retention windows (configurable per-customer), audit trail export (S3 + signed manifest)
- KMS residency options: onshore KMS integrations, HSM export controls, and whether key material stays in-custody for Private deployments.

Attachments: "Redwood_DPA_counters_v1.pdf", "ops_evidence_checklist.txt" (pack to assemble).

Rachel Kim
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
--- Attachment stub: Redwood_DPA_counters_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightline.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Alan Cho <alan.cho@brightline.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA — request for explicit no-model-learning clause + response IP

Tessa / Rachel — thank you, that level of detail helps. A couple of clarifications before our committee: 

1) The exception language for telemetry must include a list of categories that are permitted (latency, error codes, aggregate token counts) and an explicit prohibition on using any content-derived signals (no prompt n-gram level telemetry used to tune model behavior).

2) Regarding output license: Brightline prefers assignment of IP in customer-facing responses, but we can consider a perpetual exclusive license if Redwood can commit to not offering the same outputs to direct competitors for 12 months. If assignment requires additional fee, please surface that in the commercial quote.

3) Ops evidence: if you can provide an onshore KMS option and a signed sample deletion manifest (even redacted) we can close this phase.

We have a committee meeting on 11/12 and would like a final DPA version + evidence pack by EOD 11/10 to circulate internally.

Sara Lin
General Counsel, Brightline Financial
--- Attachment cited: Brightline_no_train_clause_markup.docx (Word, 35KB)
